subtitle: Markdown drafts with reviewed GitHub saves
description: Write and preview Markdown with the Rinx-backed editor in a compatible OctoSense host. Keep recoverable drafts locally; connect GitHub through host OAuth, select a repository and file, and review exact Markdown before committing. Requires the connected-services host build. Live OAuth and remote commits remain unverified; screenshots show fictional native UI fixtures.
release_notes: Development sample: local native editor and fixture repository flows checked on macOS. Not published; real provider and other-platform acceptance pending.
